servinfosub.title: Description
servinfosub.ptxt: Sonar control module monitors conditions of the system components and circuits. When an abnormal condition in the system occurs, sonar control module performs control as follows.

servinfosub.title: Self-Diagnosis Function
servinfosub.ptxt: Sonar control module has self-diagnosis function that stores DTC for abnormalities detected in parking sensor system. Stored DTCs remain in memory of sonar control module unless they are cleared.

servinfosub.title: Fail-Safe Control
servinfosub.ptxt: When any abnormality is found, sonar control module disables parking sensor system.
